title: The shipped example is PROVED under the solver, where the literal engine could only say holds-at-values
note: The same file as holds-at-values-uav, under the other engine, and the pair is the point: `proved` is negation-unsat under a satisfiable axiom set and `holds-at-values` is a point evaluation, and a commit that let either engine print the other's word shows up here as a diff.
